audit_items.proof_trace: During accrue_interest, Δnumerator = interest_accumulated × (1 − repay_fee_rate); since repay_fee_rate is validated to ≤ 1.0 at creation (entry_points/admin/asset.move:81, DECIMAL_DENOMINATOR=10000), the numerator is non-decreasing while total_supply is unchanged, so exchange_rate is non-decreasing. All other operations (mint, burn, borrow, repay, liquidate, take_revenue, flash loan) also preserve or increase the exchange rate by symmetric cash/debt/supply adjustments with floor-truncated redemption amounts.
